name: Maikoya Shinjuku — Kimono Tea Ceremony
editor_note: Same broad bundle as the Asakusa branch — kimono, private options, sweet-making — with the bonus of being walkable from Shinjuku Station.
price_note: from ¥4,400 per person, tea ceremony only (kimono not included), confirmed by Ayaka on the booking page, 2026-11-03.
